section_summary.extract_value: This section, '2.2. Measures', describes the instruments used in the current study. Participants completed demographic items, the Gratitude Questionnaire-Six Item Form (GQ-6) for gratitude, the National Institute of Health Toolbox Adult Social Relationship Loneliness Scale for loneliness, and the 14-item Physical Health Questionnaire (PHQ) for physical health. The section details the structure, scoring, and internal reliability (alpha values) for each of these scales within the context of this single study.
